text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
Duster(x) ::: x is a duster.
Premises:
Suck(plungers) ∧ Suck(vacuums) ∧ Suck(vampires) ::: Plungers suck. Vacuums suck. Vampires suck.
Vacuum(space) ::: Space is a vacuum.
Duster(duster) ∧ HouseholdAppliance(duster) ∧ ¬Suck(duster) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
¬Vampire(space) ::: Space is a vampire.
